summary: Lumen Technologies and its wholly-owned subsidiary Qwest Corporation filed an 8-K to extend the early participation date and withdrawal deadline of their exchange offers for Qwest's 6.5% Notes due 2056 and 6.75% Notes due 2057. The offers exchange the old notes for new notes with matching maturities, fully guaranteed by Lumen on an unsecured basis, and include consent solicitations to amend the indentures. This is a liability management exercise, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. The extension indicates ongoing efforts to restructure debt terms. Watch for completion deadlines and holder participation levels.
